name: Adaptive View Selection for Inpainting
aliases: 3D Inpainting Component with Adaptive View Selection
Adaptive View Selection for Inpainting — 3D Inpainting Component with Adaptive View Selection, Adaptive Weight Inpainting, Gradient-Based View Selection
definition: A component that uses a 2D image inpainter (LaMa) to provide appearance priors for occluded areas. It employs a training view selection mechanism based on regional average gradients to decide whether to use supplementary information from other views or rely on the 2D inpainter.
